pages.text: To create any scroll, place parchment and ink inside a Scribing Table. Parchment is created by coating paper in Beryllium.
Scribing is a very slow process. Different inks take different times to complete scribing.
The most basic spells are created with Astral Ink, the most basic form. Scribing takes 2 minutes.
Refined Ink creates Grand Scrolls. It is created with Light Elements, and Astral Ink. Scribing this ink takes 5 minutes.
Hateful Ink creates Evil Scrolls. it is only attainable by using Refined Ink on an Evil Star. Scribing this ink takes 30 minutes.
$(k)the men who ask lie fake despairing truths$(). $(k)this ink takes $()$(#f00)1 hour $(k)off of your lifespan$().
